compiled:
📰 General

Israel Recognizes Somaliland, Triggering Turkish Criticism and Historic Shift •

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced Friday that Israel had formally recognized Somaliland, marking the first time a country has done so. This recognition followed the signing of a “joint and mutual declaration” between the two entities, outlining areas of cooperation. The move has drawn a sharp rebuke from Turkey, a longstanding ally of Somaliland, which views the recognition as a destabilizing factor in the Horn of Africa. Analysts suggest this action primarily serves to strengthen Israel’s strategic ties with East Africa and potentially leverage Turkish influence.

🌍 World

Syria Mosque Bombing Kills Eight During Friday Prayers in Homs •

An explosion at a mosque in Homs, Syria, resulted in at least eight fatalities and 18 injuries. The attack occurred during Friday prayers, a central religious observance. Syrian authorities reported the presence of explosive devices within the targeted mosque. Initial reports indicate the blast took place in the city’s western district. Investigations into the cause and perpetrators of the attack are currently underway.

🦅 US

GDP Growth Figures Inflated: Video Game Sales Drive Unexpected Surge •

Recent reports of 4.3% GDP growth were significantly boosted by an unusual surge in video game sales, particularly Nintendo Switch titles. Data analysis revealed that the inclusion of video game revenue, influenced by tariffs on imported consoles, artificially inflated the growth rate. Economists are now re-evaluating the figures, acknowledging the impact of this specific sector. The Commerce Department is expected to revise its estimates based on this new information.

💰 Business

Salmonella Outbreak Linked to Raw Oysters Spreads Across 22 States •

The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) has confirmed a widespread Salmonella outbreak linked to the consumption of raw oysters. Sixty-four individuals across 22 states, including South Carolina, have been diagnosed with the infection. Three of the cases were identified in South Carolina, according to the agency’s report. Investigations are ongoing to determine the source and scope of the outbreak, focusing on oyster distribution and consumption patterns.

💻 Technology

Xiaomi’s 17 Ultra Phone Mimics a Real Camera with Leica’s Design •

Xiaomi’s new 17 Ultra smartphone incorporates design elements and functionality reminiscent of a traditional camera. The device features a manual lens zoom ring, a key element borrowed from Leica’s professional cameras. The phone boasts impressive camera specifications alongside the recognizable Leica Red Dot logo. This collaboration marks a significant trend among Chinese smartphone manufacturers prioritizing advanced photographic capabilities.

🎭 Entertainment

Martin Scorsese Mourns Rob Reiner, Calling His Death a “Terrible Obscenity” •

Martin Scorsese published an essay in The New York Times reflecting on the death of his longtime friend, Rob Reiner, and his wife, Michele. The essay details the deep friendship between the two filmmakers, spanning decades of collaboration and shared experiences. Scorsese expressed profound sadness and described Reiner’s passing as a “terrible obscenity,” highlighting the significant loss felt within the film industry. The piece offered a personal remembrance of Reiner’s impact and the enduring nature of their bond.

🏅 Sports

Jets Reverse Course, Announce Ashley Castanio-Gerardi Field Goal Contest •

The New York Jets have retracted their plan to offer a $100,000 prize to the first fan to successfully make a field goal attempt at practice. Initially announced by the team’s social media accounts, the decision followed reports from the New York Post. The team cited concerns about potential liability and safety issues related to the contest. Representatives stated they were evaluating the situation and would be exploring alternative ways to engage with fans. The initial announcement had generated significant media attention and public reaction.

🔬 Science

NASA’s Stunning 3I/ATLAS Image Reveals a Surprisingly Dull Comet •

Scientists analyzing NASA’s highest-resolution image of comet 3I/ATLAS have found the comet appears significantly less bright and dynamic than previously anticipated. The image, captured by the James Webb Space Telescope, contrasts sharply with older photographs of Halley’s Comet, which exhibited far greater visual complexity. Researchers attribute this difference to the comet’s composition and the way it reflects light, revealing a relatively featureless surface. The Webb telescope’s advanced capabilities highlight the challenges in interpreting data from distant celestial objects.

🩺 Health

Rising Colon Cancer Rates in Young Adults: Causes and Prevention Strategies •

Recent data indicates a concerning increase in colorectal cancer diagnoses among individuals under 50. Dr. Bethany Malone reports treating patients as young as 19, highlighting a shift in the typical age of diagnosis. Researchers attribute this rise to factors including diet, lifestyle choices, and potentially, increased screening rates. Experts recommend regular colorectal cancer screenings, starting at age 45, and emphasize the importance of a healthy diet and lifestyle to mitigate risk.
